name: Banh it
summary: Bánh ít is one of the products the Tiền Giang tourism portal lists for the Mỹ Phong noodle village, with bánh tét, hủ tiếu, bánh hỏi, and bánh tầm. A filling was not printed.
origin: Phường Mỹ Phong. The Tiền Giang tourism portal lists it among the village products.
howToEat: The tourism portal names bánh ít as a village product and prints no serving.
A price was not printed. The price is Check on arrival. A serving hour was not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Ấp Hội Gia and ấp Mỹ Hòa, phường Mỹ Phong, and old phường 9. The Đồng Tháp tourism portal prints the Hội Gia workshop as 07:00–18:00. That clock is the visit, not a cake stall.
